summary.he: הקונסול של הלשכה בכתובת ה-IP שלה, לטלפון ולמחשבים באותה רשת, עם אותה התחברות
summary.en: This office's console at its LAN address, for a phone on the same Wi-Fi, with the same sign-in

use.reason: the office's forward-auth hands a browser to signin.<domain>, which a phone on the LAN cannot resolve; lan-signin is the same image signing in at auth.<LAN_DOMAIN>, reading the office's one users file read-only
